args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site has a clean, straightforward presentation, which is great. However, it's quite minimal at the moment — I'd suggest adding more content about yourself, such as your background, interests, projects, or skills. Including a short bio, some photos, or links to your work or social profiles would make it more engaging and give visitors a better sense of who you are. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you highlight your favorite hobby, hiking — that's a wonderful theme to build a blog around! I'd suggest expanding the site with more content, such as posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, gear recommendations, or photos from your adventures. Adding regular updates and maybe some categories or tags would make it easier for readers to explore. Overall, a great start — keep sharing your hiking experiences!
